notes: No package was rebuilt to produce this record. --mode consolecheck reads a zip that already exists, so the bytes a judge met on 2026-08-14 are still on disk and are still the thing that was measured.
The arm64 reading is the DEPLOYED tree: its web/index.html is 4,655 B and its assets/index-DzVoV1YM.js is the file the live URL serves.
buildId 'dev' in the arm64 reading is a second fact about the same artefact: it shipped without MAINLINE_BUILD_ID, so the honesty chrome could not name the build a screenshot came from.
Nothing here was deployed, applied, or written to AWS. No DSN and no credential appears in this file or was read to produce it.

readings.command: python <packer extracted from scripts/deploy/build_lambda.sh> --mode consolecheck --package out/lambda/mainline-demo-api-arm64.zip --console-transport live

console.note: read from the central directory of mainline-demo-api-arm64.zip, over its web/assets/*.js entries: the bytes a browser executes, not the tree they were packed from. Everything else in this record means what it means for the directory probe.

refusals: REFUSED [PACKAGE CONSOLE TRANSPORT] --console-transport live was declared, but the web/assets/*.js inside mainline-demo-api-arm64.zip carry replay (VITE_MAINLINE_API_BASE=(empty); VITE_MAINLINE_BUNDLE_URL=./bundle/; VITE_MAINLINE_LOG_VKEY=(empty)), so the console this package serves would start REPLAY and switchable would be false. VITE_MAINLINE_API_BASE is what selects the LIVE source and .env.demo leaves it EMPTY on purpose, so it has to arrive in the ENVIRONMENT:  cd verticals/mainline/apps/console && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && VITE_MAINLINE_API_BASE=<origin> MAINLINE_BUILD_ID=<id> pnpm exec vite build --mode demo  -- and it is worth reading the compiled value back out of dist/, because on Git Bash a bare / becomes C:/Program Files/Git/ through MSYS path conversion (docs/deploy/console-build.md sec 1, observed in a real artefact 2026-08-10).
readings.why_this_case: The artefact that was serving when the founder opened the demo, declared as the thing a deployed console has to be.

readings.why_this_case: A synthetic archive carrying a non-empty VITE_MAINLINE_API_BASE. The acceptance half: a guard that only ever refuses has not discriminated either.

rule: src/app/source-select.ts:104-108 trims each of the two build-time variables and treats an empty or whitespace-only value as UNSET; :120-203 then selects LIVE when both are set (with a control), the one that is set when exactly one is, and NO SOURCE when neither is. The packer transcribes that rule once, in _classify(), and both its readers -- the directory probe and probe_console_package -- end there.
subject: the web/assets/*.js entries of out/lambda/mainline-demo-api-<arch>.zip, read through the archive's central directory. Ruling R6: not verticals/mainline/apps/console/dist, which is the packer's INPUT, and not source.
